messages.content:
Inspect this flowchart image against the requested process. Identify up to 4 specific mistakes: missing stages, wrong arrow direction or branch, overlapping boxes, unreadable text. Name the visible labels involved. Do not invent an error if the image is unclear. Return a short list of concrete corrections.

Requested process:
Create a readable directed flowchart for the following process. Use exactly the quoted stage labels. The first stage is a start node, the last is an end node, any explicitly named decision is a decision node, and all other stages are process nodes. Label decision branches exactly Yes and No. Do not add stages or connections. Begin with "Garden work begins", then "Fill watering can", then "Check soil", then the decision "Soil moist?". On No, perform "Water plant" and return directly to "Check soil" before evaluating the decision again. On Yes, perform "Store watering can", then finish at "Garden work complete".

response.text: Garden work begins which is then connected with Fi watering can which is then connected with Sol most? If Sol most? is No then Water plant and if Sol most? is Store watering can then Garden work complete. Also, Store watering can is connected with Water plant and if Soil most? is No then Soil Moist? If Soil most? is Sol most? then Soil Moist? and if Soil most? is Sol most? then Soil moist? If Soil moist? is Check soil then Store watering can and if Soil moist? is No then Garden work complete. If Soil moist? is Sol most? then Soil Moist? and if Soil moist? is Check soil then Garden work complete. Also, Garden work complete is connected with Water plant and if Soil moist? is No then Garden work complete.
